# Chat (all platforms) sub-actions

## Refresh emotes

Downloads the 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emote lists again, so Cuebot knows about new emotes.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Download again even when the cache is fresh** | Tick to always download again. Untick to reuse the saved lists when they are still fresh. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%emoteCount%` | How many emotes Cuebot knows now |

<small>Type id: `chat.refreshEmotes`</small>

## Send chat message (any platform)

Writes a chat message on one platform, or on every connected platform at once. Good for announcements.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Send to** | Pick where to write, or "All" for every connected platform. Platforms that cannot send are skipped. Options: All, Twitch, Rumble, YouTube, Kick, Streamlabs, StreamElements, TipeeeStream, DonorDrive, TreatStream, Pally.gg, StreamLoots, Crowd Control, Ko-fi, Patreon, Shopify, Fourthwall, Throne. Starts as: `All`. |
| **Message** | What to write, like "Thanks for the follow, %user%!". |
| **Reply on the platform the trigger came from** | Tick to write on the platform the action came from instead of the one picked above. It works when the action started from a chat trigger. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%sentTo%` | The platforms that got the message, separated by commas |

<small>Type id: `chat.send`</small>
